reasons.plausibility: Use of an aluminizing treatment to form Al2O3 for oxidation resistance is well-established for high-temperature alloys, though scale adhesion issues remain a concern.
reasons.testability: A direct coated vs. uncoated comparison under controlled high-temperature exposure and mechanical testing is clearly laid out and would decisively confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It addresses a key limitation (oxidation) in this high-entropy alloy system with a well-known coating approach, offering an actionable solution to a pressing practical challenge.
